description: Three coupon impacts run by the library's own explicit crash solver are wrapped in StructuralRun and read back through the two paths #1500 names — a legacy-VTK time series (the format anim_to_vtk writes) and the staged OpenRadioss case layout — then normalised into a training set: dedup, node decimation with the error it introduces, unit conversion, per-field non-dimensionalisation and a split by geometry family. Every number here is measured by the script on the machine that ran it; the LS-DYNA ASCII path is exercised by the test suite and states the quantities it cannot carry.
methods: explicit hexahedral dynamics (J2 plasticity, penalty contact)
normalisation to a training set (dedup, decimation, units, non-dimensionalisation, family split)
